notes.title: The Adventures of Mr. Poop global update!!!
notes.content:
[h3]Today we're releasing an update that will bring a lot of joy and fun:

- Added a [u]FREE DLC[/u] "Expedition to Mars"
- Added the ability to [u]PLAY WITH A FRIEND[/u] (in the DLC only)
- Changes have been made to the first winter level, it has been slightly simplified

We wish you luck and enjoy the game ːwinter2019happybulbː!!!

For all questions and suggestions, as well as in finding in-game bugs, please write to us by mail: [b]bogilom.games@gmail.com[/b][/h3]

notes.title: The Adventures of Mr. Poop announces the start of the event!
notes.content:
[h3]The first 100 players who complete the adventure all the way to the end and provide the necessary proof will be able to leave their nickname or name in the lists that are in the game lobby.

To participate in this event, you must:
[olist]
[*]  Complete the adventure.
[*]  Make a screenshot or record a video, which will confirm your passing (for example, a screenshot of achievements in the Steam library).
[*]  Send us an email to [b]bogilom.games@gmail.com[/b] with proof of completion of the adventure, and indicate the tag (nickname or name) you would like to see in the game.
[/olist]
The first 100 participants who meet the requirements of the event will be in the lists of discoverers (these lists will be posted in the lobby after the next update).
[/h3]
